summary: M.S. Computer Engineering, Rochester Institute of Technology. Built real-time embedded sensor pipelines in C++ on compute-constrained hardware, integrated multi-modal sensor data (inertial, depth, vision) into closed-loop control systems, and optimized CUDA kernels for inference on Jetson-class devices.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi Pico and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into real-time HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation; achieved PSNR of 86 vs 65 baseline.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via I2C mux and TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS into a real-time closed-loop grasping pipeline.
Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency; resolved 11 integration failures including sensor crosstalk and rolling-shutter depth errors.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object tracking; sent C++ control commands to STM32 over UART with interrupt-driven multi-servo PWM control.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensor for real-time distance estimation.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and preallocated global buffers; achieved 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) — ~35% speedup on identical accuracy.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed Cortex-M4 peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved deterministic 1 Hz sensor acquisition via timer-triggered ADC scan conversions and interrupt-driven I2C capture at 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
